verdicts.reason: A scales the headline up well for the square, but shrinks the CTA to a tiny pill stranded near the bottom edge with a huge dead gap. It also moves the LIMITED badge to the right of the button, so the CTA is buried and the badge-plus-button group comes apart. B keeps the original's proportions, order and badge-to-button grouping, but it is basically the banner placed on a square. The headline is undersized for the format, the gap between headline and CTA has grown loose, and large empty areas at the top and bottom need tightening.
